data.body:
[P2] Reconsider the unused gate callback branches

Rule 4, **Every branch has a test that fails without it**, remains broken: no fixture call or supplied test passes `on_release` or `on_hold`, so deleting their dispatch branches changes no assertion. These callbacks expand the fault-timing contract despite the description saying they were removed. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and narrow the contract to active scenarios, or establish why these callbacks are required and how their behavior will be verified.
